meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 当用户发起计算密集型任务时，Claude 自动检测本机 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘等资源，生成一个包含资源信息和策略推荐的 JSON 文件，并据此建议合适的并行处理、内存策略和 GPU 加速方案。
howto.when: 在用户要求执行数据分析、模型训练、大规模文件处理等计算密集型或资源敏感任务时触发，通常由用户主动请求资源检测或任务开始时自动调用。

say.text: 帮我对当前的系统资源做个检测，看看能跑多大的数据集。
检查一下我的GPU，是否支持PyTorch的MPS后端。
我要分析一个50GB的基因组数据，先用资源检测看看如何分块处理。
say.note: 会基于内存和磁盘给出分块或 out-of-core 策略。

howto.what_en: When a user starts a compute-intensive task, Claude automatically detects local CPU, GPU, memory, disk resources, generates a resource JSON file (.claude_resources.json) with strategic recommendations for parallel processing, memory strategy, and GPU acceleration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests resource detection or starts a resource-sensitive task like data analysis, model training, or large file processing, as instructed by the skill's usage guidelines.

say_en.text: Run a system resource check to see how much data I can handle.
Check my GPU and recommend a PyTorch backend.
say_en.note: Detects Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, or AMD GPUs.

say_en.text: I need to analyze a 50GB genomics dataset; first check resources to decide chunking.
